title: River and riverbed, wide

reference.grammar: A river crossing a park, painted in grain, with the record lying on its bed.

techniques.name: Painted grain

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: Size of one grain, in screen pixels. Every grain takes one color from a short ramp; 1 lays the ground at the screen’s own pixel, the page drew it at 2 on a retina screen.

speck.label: Speckle
speck.note: How far chance moves a grain along its ramp. 0 leaves only the light field and the brush streaks; higher breaks every tone into speckle.

fray.label: Bank fray
fray.note: How ragged the water’s edge is, grain by grain.

flowers.label: Flowers
flowers.note: Share of grains in the meadow patches that print as pink, pale yellow and violet flowers.

record.label: Riverbed glow
record.note: Share of grains over each strand of the record that print as its glow: green for yours, white for the model’s.

techniques.implementation: Ground and water are laid in as grain: every pixel takes one color from a short ramp, chosen by a field of light, a streak of brushwork and chance, so light blooms and falls off in speckle and nothing has a hard edge. The record lies on the bed as two kinds of glow.

techniques.name: River

width.label: Width
width.note: Half-width of the river against the height of the plate.

meander.label: Meander
meander.note: Depth of the river’s long bend.

sun.label: Sun along the river
sun.note: Where the light on the water sits along the current.

light.label: Sun on the water
light.note: Reach and strength of the bloom of light on the water.

techniques.implementation: One centerline with a slowly varying width; banks wander about it by noise; three islands part the current; a light field of broad sweeps, a worn path and a sun on the water.

techniques.name: Hand marks

grass.label: Grass
grass.note: Count of tapered grass strokes, leaning with the wind.

current.label: Current
current.note: Count of long current strokes that part round the islands, and of the glints running down the water.

bank.label: Bank line
bank.note: Weight of the broken dark line where water meets land.

techniques.implementation: Tapered strokes of a loaded brush over the grain: grass on land, current in the water, a dark line at the bank that thickens, thins and breaks.

techniques.name: Time

speed.label: Speed
speed.note: How fast the river’s clock runs when the plate plays: current, koi, canoe, walkers, kite.

moment.label: Moment
moment.note: The time on the river’s clock the still shows, and where Play starts.

techniques.implementation: Everything that moves reads one clock: glints and koi ride the current, the canoe passes from one model’s reach to the next, people and robots walk the banks.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.
